content_of_post_to_answer: How can you stop being so hard on yourself and improve your mental health?
answer: Being hard on yourself often looks like a desire to improve, but many people confuse self-criticism with self-awareness. Growth comes from examining your actions without turning them into a judgment of your worth. I explore this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The voice that helps you change is rarely the same voice that keeps attacking you.
